shared_elements: horizontal register bands dividing the surface
repeated row of similar motifs along a band
low-relief carving on a flat vertical stone face
animals/creatures in profile (B) vs. plant motifs (A) — only 'repeated figural row' is shared
justification: Both surfaces organise their content into stacked horizontal registers with a repeated row of similar units in the upper band, and both use flat low-relief outlining, which is the strongest correspondence. But the depicted content is quite different: A shows purely vegetal/geometric ornament (rosettes, palmette-like fronds, interlaced arcs, chevrons) with no living creatures, whereas B is entirely zoomorphic (rows of quadrupeds under arcs, a bird of prey, snakes, a long-necked bird) with no floral motifs.
